result.title: P$^2$-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
result.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 P$^2$-MOPD，把学生与多个专家参数的线性组合视为单一可微模型，在同一 on-policy 蒸馏目标下同时优化合并系数与可训练的学生权重，使专家仅作为参数先验；在 1.7B/4B 四个领域上恢复更快更均衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属多教师蒸馏与参数先验训练，本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理；其「可学习合并系数＋可训练学生」的多能力组合方式，或可供核查用于组合 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等推理行为的多种专家监督，但迁移可行性尚待验证。
